source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

parts.target: A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER** unit of yours on the battlefield.
parts.effect:
Every unit on the battlefield in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos) takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), with -1 to it if that unit is **Below Half-strength**.

**Designer’s Note**: your own units and enemy units in your army's Shadow of Chaos both take this test. It lets you heal units of yours through the army rule [Daemonic Manifestation](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos), at the risk of some of your own units becoming **battle-shocked**.
